system.description: Perfected by the Tremere assassin Victor, who shares it sparingly, this ten-minute ritual hardens the caster's hands into razor-sharp weapons that deal an extra die of damage in unarmed combat. The effect lasts until the next sunrise. A Vampire under its effect must handle delicate objects — and herself — with great care.
system.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred (Victor's own creation)
